content.title: How to Watch | Denver Nuggets
content.text: Regional Broadcast The local TV home for the Denver Nuggets continues to be Altitude Sports. Fans can watch the majority of the Nuggets games on Altitude Sports through their TV provider. Altitude on FUBO Watch games on Altitude through Fubo. Start a free 14-day trial today! Altitude+ Streaming App Altitude+ is the new streaming home of Altitude Sports. Fans can stream award winning broadcasts of Nuggets and Avalanche games, plus pre and postgame coverage, full episodes of Altitude Sports originals and more! TV Partners Altitude Sports on 9News Altitude Sports partners with 9News to broadcast 20 Nuggets games over the air.Learn More NBC/Peacock Select Nuggets games in the 2025-26 season will be broadcast on NBC & streamed on Peacock!
